title: Everyone's laundry
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Four days of rain and the laundromat is full: every dryer, every chair, the whole town's wet clothes. A room of readers. The digest goes hand to hand. Wood watches from the folding table and doesn't draw them. He can't draw a whole town at once yet.

panels.composition: The laundromat packed: every dryer turning, every chair taken, baskets on the floor, coats steaming. Faces of every age.

image.prompt: a crowded small-town laundromat with every dryer turning and every chair taken, wet coats steaming, people of every age, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A digest going from a woman to a man to a KID. Three readers in one panel.

image.prompt: a small photocopied booklet being passed from a woman to a man to a child in a crowded laundromat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD at the folding table with the pad. Not drawing. Watching a whole room read.

image.prompt: a young man at a laundromat folding table holding a pen over a blank pad, watching a crowded room, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The room again. Wood small in it. BARNABY under the table. The strip is one panel behind the room and knows it.

image.prompt: a crowded laundromat seen from the door with a young man small at a folding table and a small dog beneath it, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: A whole room reading. He can't draw a town at once yet. 2004 will.
